name: Craven Drok
summary: Craven Drok is a wandering orc found skulking in the dimly lit tunnels of the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. True to his moniker, he keeps to the dark corners of the city, occasionally reaching out to travelers willing to help with a delicate matter: how the Alliance sees the Horde.

sections.title: A Skulker in the Shadows
sections.body: While most orcs of Orgrimmar proudly walk the sunlit avenues of the Valley of Honor or the Valley of Strength, Craven Drok avoids the daylight entirely. He haunts the winding, subterranean paths of the Cleft of Shadow, an enclave typically reserved for warlocks, rogues, and practitioners of less honorable trades. Drok lives up to his cowardly reputation, preferring to stay out of sight while hiring passersby to carry out his discreet errands, including an errand concerning the Horde's standing with the Alliance.

faq.q: Where can I find Craven Drok?
faq.answer: Craven Drok wanders the cavernous underground pathways of the Cleft of Shadow, situated deep beneath the main thoroughfares of Orgrimmar.

Orcish culture prizes overt bravery and martial glory above all else. Drok earns his moniker by skulking in dark caverns, keeping his head down, and contracting others to handle tasks he prefers not to deal with personally.

faq.q: What is his involvement with the Alliance?
faq.answer: Drok starts the errand known as Alliance Relations. He speaks of Thrall as a wise diplomat who learned much of human ways, then sends travelers to Keldran, who works to keep the Alliance from wrongly concluding that the Horde has made pacts with the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Who does Craven Drok send travelers to?
faq.answer: He sends them to Keldran, a student of magic whose hovel lies near the western exit of Orgrimmar. With the Warchief's blessing, Keldran works to make sure the Horde is not mistaken for an ally of the Burning Legion.

angles.text: Most orcs regard Craven Drok with disdain, as his preference for lurking in the gloomy Cleft of Shadow stands in stark contrast to traditional notions of orcish honor and courage.
The Cleft of Shadow is the natural gathering place for those who operate outside the spotlight, making contacts like Drok typical of the subterranean underworld beneath the capital.
